optimizedContext.value:
# Continuous Integration

## Rules

- Track `.github/workflows/ci.yml`; keep remaining `.github/` ignored, including agent files, skill copies, `copilot-instructions.md`.
- Run identical job on `macos-latest`, `ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest`; any runner failure fails check.
- Trigger pull requests and pushes to `main`; never call Gemini workflows.
- Each job: checkout; install pnpm `10.6.5`; install Node 22; run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
- Install builds `better-sqlite3`, `@ast-grep/lang-go`, `@ast-grep/lang-php`, `@ast-grep/lang-python`, `esbuild`; add no apt, brew, or Chocolatey packages.
- Run, in order: `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`.
- Build/typecheck skip `@specd/public-web`.
- Test via Vitest: `@specd/core`, `@specd/cli`, `@specd/code-graph`, `@specd/guide`, `@specd/sdk`, `@specd/skills`, `@specd/plugin-manager`, all five `@specd/plugin-agent-*` packages. Exclude `@specd/mcp`, `@specd/public-web`.
- Never run changeset status or publish.

## Constraints

- GitHub Actions only; no new test runner.
- Gemini workflow files may remain tracked; behavior out of scope.
